stem:
The conversion of degrees Celsius to degrees Fahrenheit can be represented by a linear relationship. The graph shows the linear relationship between y, the temperature in degrees Fahrenheit, and x, the temperature in degrees Celsius from the freezing point of water.

[Graph showing a line from (0,32) Fahrenheit to (45,113) Fahrenheit approximately, plotted against degrees Celsius on x-axis 0 to 45 and degrees Fahrenheit on y-axis 32 to 112.]

Which equation best represents this situation?
visual_elements: Graph showing line from (0,32) to about (45,113) with x-axis labeled Degrees Celsius and y-axis labeled Degrees Fahrenheit.
